payloads.name: Cloudflare trace + CF-RAY WebSocket
payloads.description: Classic cdn-cgi/trace probe then CF-RAY upgrade to your host. Works with many zero-rated bundles.
payloads.payload: GET /cdn-cgi/trace HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: openwho.org[crlf][crlf]CF-RAY / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf]Connection: Upgrade[crlf]X-Real-Host: 127.0.0.1:22[crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: CF trace with Proxy-Authorization
payloads.description: Trace request with optional proxy auth header slot, then CF-RAY WS upgrade.
payloads.payload: GET /cdn-cgi/trace HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [your_host][crlf]X-Forwarded-For: 1.1.1.1[crlf]Proxy-Authorization: Basic [base64-encoded-username:password][crlf]Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf]User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)[crlf][crlf]CF-RAY / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf]Connection: Upgrade[crlf]User-Agent: [ua][crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: African Storybook CF-RAY chain
payloads.description: CONNECT + instant_split + africanstorybook trace chain. Popular in East Africa ISP bypass.
payloads.payload: CONNECT [host_port] HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]X-Online-Host: r.airtelkenya.com[crlf]X-Forward-Host: r.airtelkenya.com[crlf]Proxy-Authorization: Basic QXMxMnc4OkFzMTJ3OA==[crlf]Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf][instant_split]GET /cdn-cgi/trace HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: africanstorybook.org[crlf][crlf]CF-RAY / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]Upgrade: Websocket[crlf]Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf]User-Agent: [ua][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf][crlf]
payloads.notes: Replace Proxy-Authorization with your carrier credentials if required.

payloads.name: OpenWHO trace + proxy auth variant
payloads.payload: GET /cdn-cgi/trace HTTP/1.1[crlf]Proxy-Authorization: Basic QXMxMnc4OkFzMTJ3OA==[crlf]Host: openwho.org[crlf][crlf]CF-RAY / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [Host][crlf]Upgrade: Websocket[crlf]Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf]User-Agent: [ua][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: HEAD bootstrapcdn + GET split
payloads.description: HTTP Custom v5 style split: HEAD to CDN then GET WebSocket upgrade to your SSH host.
payloads.payload: HEAD / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com[crlf][crlf][split]GET / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]Connection: Upgrade[crlf]Speed-100: [crlf]Upgrade: Websocket[crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: YouTube CONNECT + instant_split
payloads.description: Mimics YouTube HTTP then CONNECT tunnel. Useful where video domains are zero-rated.
payloads.payload: GET http://www.youtube.com/ HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: www.youtube.com[crlf]X-Online-Host: www.youtube.com[crlf]X-Forward-Host: www.youtube.com[crlf]X-Forwarded-For: www.youtube.com[crlf]Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf]User-Agent: [ua][crlf]Referer: www.youtube.com[crlf][crlf][instant_split]CONNECT [host_port] [protocol][crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: DLight coregateway WebSocket
payloads.description: Simple GET upgrade via coregateway.app.dlight.com host header.
payloads.payload: GET / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: coregateway.app.dlight.com[crlf]Connection: Upgrade[crlf]User-Agent: [ua][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf]Expect: 100-continue[crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: Basic double Upgrade header
payloads.description: Minimal WebSocket payload — pair with your domain as Host.
payloads.payload: GET / HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: [host][crlf]Upgrade: websocket[crlf]Connection: Upgrade[crlf]X-Real-Host: 127.0.0.1:22[crlf][crlf]

payloads.name: WS tunnel site fronting
payloads.description: WebSocket via tunnel site host. Use with wildcard *.tunnel.site patterns.
payloads.payload: GET wss://SNI_bug_host/ HTTP/1.1[crlf]Host: ca1.wstunnel.site[crlf]Upgrade: Websocket[crlf]Connection: Keep-Alive[crlf][crlf]
payloads.notes: Replace SNI_bug_host with your SNI. Wildcard format: cloudflare.com.ca1.wstunnel.site
